redistribution.committedContent: Aggregate counts, per-header hashes and provenance only. No symbol identifiers, no header text, no struct layouts.

denominatorCaveats: The count is the number of symbol rows this extractor can attribute structurally. It is not a claim that the SDK's public surface is fully enumerated.
unsupported-or-unknown is dominated by plain data types, which have no call direction to classify. It is not a count of missing callables.
Headers marked deprecated (the *Old.h variants) do not reduce the denominator; their symbols are counted in their functional class and flagged separately.
Classification is rule-based and provisional. Rule tallies are reported so a reviewer can see exactly which rule produced each class.
No behavioural claim about any AE build is implied. Nothing here was executed against After Effects.

evidenceLevel.statement: Symbols were extracted from AE SDK 26.5 macOS headers by a deterministic parser. No After Effects process was started; no plug-in was built or loaded; no symbol was executed. Windows headers were not obtained; Windows ABI/layout claims are UNVERIFIED.
